import importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('tmp/work-sync-acceptance')
sid='ws-fd453142b30a4d9ebd8dba77952c29ed'
dp=root/(sid+'-draft.json'); pp=root/(sid+'-packet.json'); vp=root/(sid+'-preview.md')
draft=json.loads(dp.read_text(encoding='utf-8')); previous=json.loads(pp.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert draft['submission_id']==previous['submission_id']==sid
assert draft['request_key']==previous['request_key']
draft['open_questions']=['尚需验证按阶段检索是否方便']
draft['artifacts']=[x for x in draft['artifacts'] if x.get('name')=='result.txt']
assert len(draft['artifacts'])==1
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('draft_helper',r'[USER_HOME]\\.agents\\skills\\teambrain\\scripts\\prepare-work-sync.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
packet=m.prepare(draft,previous)
assert packet['submission_id']==sid and packet['request_key']==previous['request_key']
assert packet['created_at']==previous['created_at']
assert packet['state']=='awaiting_confirmation'
dp.write_text(json.dumps(draft,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
pp.write_text(json.dumps(packet,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
vp.write_text(packet['record_content'],encoding='utf-8')
check=json.loads(pp.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert check['record_content']==vp.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert '尚需验证按阶段检索是否方便' in check['record_content']
print(json.dumps({'submission_id':check['submission_id'],'request_key_unchanged':True,'state':check['state'],'paths':[x['path'] for x in check['files']],'fingerprint':check['request_fingerprint']},ensure_ascii=True))
'@ | python -"
